thread:
sam: Heads-up — ran into a leak in the Go generator sample when cancelling with ctx. Quick repro: start Generator, cancel after first chunk, and pprof shows a goroutine stuck in handshake read (waiting on ack channel).

kelly: thanks for the repro. i can repro on linux. looks like the handshake reader never observes ctx.Done() in the early-exit path.

joel: can you paste the tiny example?

sam: sure:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
iter := client.Generator(ctx, req)
go func() { time.Sleep(25*time.Millisecond); cancel() }()
for iter.Next() { _ = iter.Token() }
if err := iter.Err(); err != nil { log.Println("iter err:", err) }
```
After cancel the iterator stops but a goroutine remains in generator/handshake.go:handshakeReader.

maria: oof. two quick ways to mitigate: (1) make iterator implement io.Closer and update samples to `defer iter.Close()`; (2) make runtime auto-clean on ctx.Done() using an idempotent cleanup (sync.Once) so samples don't need Close. prefer both.

kelly: agree. added benefit: expose a ForEach(ctx, fn) convenience to reduce users misusing Next/Err. ForEach should accept func(context.Context, Token) error so it can early-return.

joel: tests: add a unit to assert ack channel closed exactly once, and an integration that cancels mid-stream and verifies goroutine count returns to baseline within 150ms. mark integration as flaky-friendly (skip race detector).

sam: also check auth retry wiring — if a mid-stream auth refresh triggers a retry while ctx is cancelled we might left-over handshake state. plz audit the auth retry path.

maria: good call. i'll add an audit checklist item for auth/refresh/resume paths and Dedicated/private adapters.

dev-bot: Created issue #412: "go-sdk: generator sample goroutine leak on ctx cancel; audit auth/retry paths" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/issues/412

kelly: i'll open a draft PR implementing: io.Closer on iterator, ForEach helper, internal ctx watcher with sync.Once cleanup, and the tests mentioned. will tag @maria for the auth audit.

joel: thanks. sample repo update: show both ForEach quickstart and manual pattern with `defer iter.Close()` in the onboarding guide. mention cancellation best-practices and link the issue.

sam: thanks all. ping here when PR is ready and i'll validate the sample app and run the pprof check. :rocket:
